citations.quote: three key factors, at least one of which must be present in order to give rise to a licensing obligation
secondly, the family office is carrying on a business in the provision of such services; and thirdly, the business is carried on in Hong Kong.

readings.distinction: The direct connective reading is inclusive OR. True includes one, two or three satisfied factors. There is no negation in the target clause. Reading the enumerative “and” as requiring all three would need an additional contextual assumption that the explicit threshold itself does not supply. This is the preferred reading of the selected antecedent.

where the provision of services is carried on as a business, increases the likelihood of a licensing obligation arising.

readings.distinction: The rival concerns modal attachment: “must” makes the disjunctive threshold necessary for an obligation, while leaving sufficiency unspecified. Its necessary threshold is expressible as OR, but equating that threshold with the requested satisfied trigger would add the assumption disputed here. Neither a cumulative three-factor trigger nor any other sufficient combination follows uniquely.
